domain_description: Comprehensive enterprise and business law analysis covering business formation, corporate governance, mergers and acquisitions, business valuation, joint ventures, franchise law, business succession, commercial contracts, supply chain management, risk management, compliance programs, and crisis management. Grounded in the DGCL, Model Business Corporation Act, UCC, Hart-Scott-Rodino Act, and federal/state business statutes.
authority_sources: Revised Uniform Limited Liability Company Act (RULLCA)

engines.name: Business Formation Engine
engines.function: Analyze entity selection and formation options including corporations, LLCs, partnerships, sole proprietorships, and benefit corporations. Evaluate liability protection, tax treatment, governance flexibility, and operational requirements by jurisdiction.
doctrine_topics: entity type comparison (C Corp, S Corp, LLC, LP, GP)
state of formation selection factors (Delaware, Nevada, Wyoming, home state)
benefit corporation and social enterprise structures
piercing the corporate veil factors and prevention

golden_queries.question: Three co-founders are starting a SaaS company. They want to raise venture capital, issue stock options to employees, and eventually pursue an IPO. One founder will contribute IP, one will contribute cash, and one will contribute services. Analyze the optimal entity structure and formation strategy.
required_elements: Delaware C corporation advantages for VC funding
83(b) election for founders receiving restricted stock
authorized share structure for option pool
failure_signals: failure to address IP contribution tax issues

engines.name: Corporate Governance Engine
engines.function: Analyze corporate governance structures, board of directors duties, shareholder rights, executive compensation, proxy contests, and governance best practices under state corporate law and federal securities requirements.
doctrine_topics: board of directors fiduciary duties (care, loyalty, good faith)
business judgment rule and its limitations
Revlon duties in sale of control transactions
Unocal enhanced scrutiny for defensive measures
officer and director indemnification and D&O insurance

golden_queries.question: A board of directors receives an unsolicited acquisition offer at a 40% premium. The board rejects the offer without consulting financial advisors and adopts a poison pill. Three activist shareholders demand a special meeting to remove the board. Analyze the board's fiduciary duties and the validity of the defensive measures under Unocal and Revlon.
required_elements: Unocal enhanced scrutiny test (reasonableness and proportionality)
board's duty to inform itself before rejecting
shareholder rights to call special meeting
failure_signals: failure to analyze poison pill proportionality

engines.name: Mergers Acquisitions Engine
engines.function: Analyze M&A transaction structures including asset purchases, stock purchases, mergers, tender offers, and leveraged buyouts. Evaluate due diligence, deal protection mechanisms, regulatory approvals, and integration planning.
doctrine_topics: asset purchase vs stock purchase vs merger structure comparison
letter of intent and exclusivity provisions
due diligence scope and material adverse change clauses
deal protection mechanisms (break-up fees, no-shop, go-shop)
closing conditions and material adverse effect definition
post-closing purchase price adjustments (working capital, earnout)

golden_queries.question: A private equity firm wants to acquire a $200 million manufacturing company through a leveraged buyout using 60% debt financing. The target has operations in the US and Germany, 800 employees, and a pending environmental remediation obligation. Analyze the optimal deal structure, key due diligence areas, and regulatory approval requirements.
required_elements: LBO structure and debt financing considerations
HSR filing threshold and timing analysis
failure_signals: failure to address cross-border regulatory issues

engines.name: Business Valuation Engine
engines.function: Analyze business valuation methodologies including income approach, market approach, and asset approach. Evaluate valuation discounts, premium calculations, and valuation for specific purposes (litigation, tax, M&A, divorce).
doctrine_topics: comparable company and comparable transaction analysis
minority interest and marketability discounts (DLOM, DLOC)
valuation for estate and gift tax purposes (IRC 2031)
valuation for divorce and marital dissolution
fair value vs fair market value distinction

golden_queries.question: Value a privately held oil service company with $15 million EBITDA, $5 million capex, $8 million net debt, 15% annual revenue growth, and no comparable public companies. The valuation is for a minority interest gift to family members. Analyze the appropriate methodology and applicable discounts.
required_elements: DCF valuation with projections and terminal value
failure_signals: failure to address minority and marketability discounts

engines.name: Joint Ventures Engine
engines.function: Analyze joint venture structures including corporate JVs, LLC JVs, contractual JVs, and consortium arrangements. Evaluate governance, capital contribution, profit sharing, deadlock resolution, and exit mechanisms.
doctrine_topics: joint venture entity selection (LLC vs Corp vs contractual)
capital contribution obligations and funding mechanisms
deadlock resolution mechanisms (swing vote, mediation, buy-sell)

golden_queries.question: Two competing oil companies want to form a joint venture to develop a new shale play. Company A will contribute acreage (60%) and Company B will contribute capital and operations expertise (40%). They disagree on governance — both want operational control. Design the JV structure and governance framework.
required_elements: LLC vs corporate JV comparison for oil and gas

engines.name: Franchise Law Engine
engines.function: Analyze franchise law compliance including FTC Franchise Rule, state registration requirements, franchise disclosure document preparation, franchise agreement analysis, and franchisee/franchisor dispute resolution.
doctrine_topics: FTC Franchise Rule (16 CFR 436) disclosure requirements
state franchise registration and filing requirements
vicarious liability and joint employer issues in franchising

golden_queries.question: A restaurant chain with 50 company-owned locations wants to begin franchising. They have no FDD and no franchise registration. They have already signed 3 'license agreements' with friends who are operating under the brand. Analyze the compliance violations and remediation steps required.
required_elements: state registration requirements in registration states
failure_signals: failure to identify existing agreements as franchise sales

engines.name: Business Succession Engine
engines.function: Analyze business succession planning strategies including buy-sell agreements, management transition, ownership transfer mechanisms, key person planning, and family business governance structures.
doctrine_topics: buy-sell agreement structures (cross-purchase, entity redemption, hybrid)
buy-sell funding mechanisms (life insurance, installment, sinking fund)
buy-sell valuation provisions and trigger events
key person life and disability insurance
employee stock ownership plan (ESOP) as succession tool
generational wealth transfer and estate planning integration
business continuity planning for ownership events

golden_queries.question: A 65-year-old owner of a $20 million oil service company wants to transition ownership to 2 of 3 children who work in the business, while treating the third child fairly. The owner wants to remain involved for 5 years. Analyze the succession structure options including buy-sell, gifting, GRAT, ESOP, and installment sale to an IDGT.
required_elements: ESOP analysis for liquidity and tax benefits
failure_signals: failure to address non-participating child equity

engines.name: Commercial Contracts Engine
engines.function: Analyze commercial contract structures including supply agreements, distribution agreements, licensing arrangements, service contracts, and master service agreements under UCC and common law principles.
doctrine_topics: master service agreement (MSA) framework and SOW structure
supply agreement quantity and delivery terms (UCC 2-306, 2-307)
software licensing and SaaS agreement terms
service level agreements (SLA) and performance metrics
limitation of liability and consequential damage waivers

golden_queries.question: A company wants to enter into a 5-year exclusive supply agreement for a critical raw material. The supplier demands a minimum purchase obligation of $10 million per year, while the buyer wants flexibility for demand fluctuations. Analyze the key contract provisions needed to balance both parties' interests.
required_elements: requirements contract vs minimum purchase obligation (UCC 2-306)
force majeure and supply disruption provisions

engines.name: Supply Chain Engine
engines.function: Analyze supply chain legal and compliance issues including procurement contracts, logistics agreements, trade compliance, product liability allocation, and supply chain risk management.
doctrine_topics: supply chain due diligence and compliance (Dodd-Frank conflict minerals)
product liability allocation in supply chain
supplier quality requirements and audit rights
supply chain disruption force majeure analysis
customs and trade compliance in supply chain
sustainability and ESG requirements for suppliers
supply chain cybersecurity and data protection

golden_queries.question: A US manufacturer sources components from 3 countries (China, Mexico, Germany), assembles in Texas, and ships finished products to customers in 15 countries. A key Chinese supplier's factory was shut down by government order for 90 days. Analyze the supply chain legal issues including force majeure, alternative sourcing, and customer liability.
required_elements: force majeure clause interpretation for government shutdown
supply agreement remedies and cure periods
tariff and trade compliance for alternative suppliers
failure_signals: failure to address downstream customer obligations

engines.name: Risk Management Engine
engines.function: Analyze enterprise risk management frameworks, insurance program design, contractual risk transfer, business continuity planning, and emerging risk identification for commercial and industrial operations.
doctrine_topics: insurance program structure and coverage analysis
business continuity and disaster recovery planning
product liability risk assessment and mitigation
captive insurance company formation and management

golden_queries.question: An oilfield services company with 500 employees, $100 million revenue, and operations in 5 states wants to design a comprehensive insurance program. Current losses include 3 auto accidents, 2 workers comp claims over $100K, and one environmental cleanup. Analyze the optimal insurance program structure and risk retention strategy.
required_elements: general liability and umbrella coverage analysis

engines.name: Compliance Programs Engine
engines.function: Design and evaluate corporate compliance programs including program structure, risk assessment, policies and procedures, training, monitoring, investigation, and effectiveness metrics per DOJ guidance.
doctrine_topics: DOJ evaluation of corporate compliance programs framework
compliance program metrics and effectiveness measurement
board oversight and compliance committee reporting

golden_queries.question: A company received a DOJ subpoena related to potential FCPA violations by a foreign subsidiary. The company has a written compliance policy but no dedicated compliance officer, no training program, no third-party due diligence, and no hotline. Analyze the compliance program deficiencies under the DOJ Evaluation of Corporate Compliance Programs framework.
required_elements: DOJ three-part framework (well-designed, adequately resourced, works in practice)
failure_signals: failure to identify specific program gaps

engines.name: Crisis Management Engine
engines.function: Analyze crisis management and response strategies including incident response planning, regulatory crisis management, litigation crisis, reputational crisis, and business continuity during crisis events.
doctrine_topics: crisis response team structure and activation
regulatory crisis notification and response timeline
litigation hold and document preservation obligations
media and public communications during crisis
board notification and oversight during crisis

golden_queries.question: An oil company experiences a major pipeline rupture that releases 10,000 barrels of crude oil into a river, killing fish and threatening a municipal water supply. Media is on scene, regulators are calling, and the stock price is dropping. Analyze the immediate crisis response obligations across legal, regulatory, environmental, and communications domains.
required_elements: media response and crisis communication strategy
